Subject: OpticSoft renewal + uplift coordination — timeline & QBR readout

Hi Helen / Tom —

Following our renewal alert last week, I wanted to kick off a short coordination thread to align on the renewal term, proposed capacity uplift, and a QBR readout slot to present the recommended performance/cost plan. High level ask: confirm stakeholder availability for a 30–45 minute QBR in the next 7–10 business days so we can lock the mutual action plan.

Proposed agenda for the QBR (we'll circulate a slidedeck before the meeting):
- Quick health check (usage, latency, cost) — Monica
- Recommended capacity uplift & staging plan — Karthik
- Contract term options (12/24/36 mo) and pricing impact — David
- Implementation timeline and roles — Laura

Immediate asks for OpticSoft:
1) Can you confirm who should be on the QBR (technical + procurement)?
2) Do you have any blackout dates next week for a 30–45m slot?
3) Are there any procurement constraints (PO process / renewal approver) we should be aware of?

Attachments: I attached a first-pass Mutual Action Plan with proposed milestones and a calendar file with a few suggested slots. If helpful, we can prioritize an exec readout for the renewal approver.

Thanks — looping in Monica and Laura who will run the QBR and handle the capacity sizing work: Monica (CS lead), Laura (account lead), Karthik (solutions).

Best,
David Kim
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
(david.kim@redwoodinference.com)

Attachment: OpticSoft_Mutual_Action_Plan.xlsx (spreadsheet)
Attachment: QBR-proposed-slots.ics (calendar)

From: Helen Zhao <helen.zhao@opticsoft.com>

Date: 2028-07-17T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: OpticSoft renewal + uplift coordination — timeline & QBR readout

Thanks David — appreciate the clear agenda. Quick answers:

- QBR participants: me (VP Product), Tom (Head of Platform), and I'll invite our procurement lead (Marissa Connors) once we lock the slot. Technically we'll also want one of our infra engineers on the call — I expect Tom will add that person.
- Blackout: We have an internal offsite on 2028-07-20, so any time that day won't work. Other than that morning of 2028-07-19 is tight.
- Procurement: We require two approvers for any multi-year commit; PO payment terms are net30. We may want to run a short legal review if there are any material term changes.

Can you and your team prepare: a one-slide summary of how the uplift maps to observed token demand, and an explicit cost delta for 12 vs 24 months? That will help our procurement and execs evaluate options quickly.

Happy to take the 2028-07-18 10:00–10:45 PT slot if that fits your team.

—Helen
VP Product, OpticSoft
helen.zhao@opticsoft.com
